s.t:
Deine Rolle
Als Product Manager BESS & PCS (m/w/d) übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Produktfamilie der Outdoor-Energiespeichersysteme von STABL sowie für unsere proprietäre Leistungselektronik. Deine Mission ist es, wettbewerbsfähige, hochwertige Produkte zu gestalten, die echte Kundenbedürfnisse lösen und das Wachstum von STABL unterstützen.

Du wandelst Erkenntnisse aus Markt, Kunden und Stakeholdern in eine klare Produktausrichtung um und arbeitest funktionsübergreifend daran, das Portfolio kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Als Teil des Business Innovation Teams stellst du sicher, dass Marktfeedback klar in unsere Organisation eingebracht und anschließend umgesetzt wird.
Deine Mission
Du verwaltest nicht nur eine Roadmap – du gestaltest aktiv die nächste Generation von Energiespeichersystemen in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der groß denkt, gerne Hardware und Software miteinander verbindet und Produkte entwickeln möchte, die Kunden begeistern – für ein skalierendes und sich gleichzeitig kontinuierlich weiterentwickelndes Produkt in einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Branchen der Energiewende.
Du sammelst Kunden- und Marktanforderungen und übersetzt diese in klare Produktanforderungen und Prioritäten.
Du stellst die technische Exzellenz, die kommerzielle Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Gesamtqualität der Lösungen sicher.
Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, dem Markt sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern.
Du führst Wettbewerbsanalysen und Marktforschung durch, um Trends, Chancen und Risiken zu identifizieren. Dabei arbeitest du an Systemen, die an gewerblichen und industriellen Standorten eingesetzt werden, und sorgst für die richtige Balance zwischen Leistung, Kosten und Sicherheit in einem sich schnell weiterentwickelnden regulatorischen Umfeld.
Du bereitest strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und präsentierst diese. Außerdem steuerst du Produkte und zugehörige Initiativen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der Konzeption und Validierung bis hin zur Markteinführung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Dein Profil
Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Product Ownership, idealerweise im Cleantech-, EPC-, Industrie-, Elektronikbereich oder einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld sowie mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Energiespeicherung, idealerweise mit BESS.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Kunden-, Markt- und Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Produktanforderungen, Prioritäten und Roadmap-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Management von Produkt-Roadmaps sowie in der bereichsübergreifenden Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Fachbereichen.
Starkes analytisches und strategisches Denkvermögen sowie Erfahrung in den Bereichen Marktforschung, Wettbewerbsanalyse und Produktpositionierung.
Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, vertrauensvoll mit Kunden, Partnern und internen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Strukturierte, proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise; Erfahrung mit B2B-Kunden aus dem Energie- oder Infrastrukturbereich ist von Vorteil.
Warum STABL Energy?
STABL Energy gehört zu den innovativsten Start-ups der Energiewende, ist Gewinner des ees Award 2022 , des pv magazine Award 2025 und wurde als eines der Top 100 Energy Start-ups weltweit ausgezeichnet. Wir werden von renommierten und erfahrenen Tech-VCs aus Deutschland, Dänemark und der Schweiz unterstützt.
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Agile, offene und innovationsgetriebene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und echter Eigenverantwortung.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge zur Unterstützung deiner Zukunftsplanung.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell sowie die Möglichkeit, zeitweise aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Digitale Essensgutscheine mit Circula Lunch – genieße dein Mittagessen auf uns!
Monatlicher Sachbezug, den du bei deinen Lieblingsgeschäften einlösen kannst.

Regelmäßige Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Team-Events.
EGYM Wellpass – trainiere ohne Limits in zahlreichen Fitnessstudios in ganz Deutschland.
Bereit, Innovation voranzutreiben, etwas zu bewegen und andere zu inspirieren? Bewirb dich jetzt!
Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und gemeinsam mit dir das Energiesystem der Zukunft zu gestalten! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich zu bewerben. Unser Motto lautet „Hire for attitude, train for skills“ – deshalb schätzen wir Potenzial und lebenslanges Lernen genauso sehr wie Erfahrung.

We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of our products and drive company-wide impact! This is a senior-level, subject-matter-expert role that combines strategic vision with hands-on leadership across multiple teams.

The Product team works to design, develop, and manage user-centered digital products that align with our business goals. Through close collaboration with stakeholders, user feedback, and data-driven insights, we deliver innovative and reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Reporting to the Director of Product, you’ll define and deliver a 2–3 year product strategy that aligns with the company’s long-term vision. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to shape development practices, influence roadmaps, and ensure consistent product direction across teams.

As an individual contributor and domain expert, you’ll raise the bar for Product Management through mentorship, technical depth, and scalable processes that promote fact-based problem solving and continuous improvement. This is a remote-first role within the GTA.

Responsibilities: Act as a strategic thought leader, creating clear and inspiring narratives that align teams and stakeholders around a shared product vision.

Define, own, and gain buy-in for the 2-3 year product vision of the assigned domain, and develop a concrete 18-24 month strategy and roadmap that ensures alignment with the overall product and business strategy. Collaborate with Product leaders to co-develop and optimize the overarching 18-24 month product strategy and roadmap.

Partner with Product leadership to shape cross-domain priorities, coordinate resources, and maintain alignment across multiple teams. Serve as the strategic hub and arbiter for product and development teams, resolving significant dependencies and conflicting priorities to drive successful delivery.

Lead end-to-end problem solving from strategy to execution, balancing business and technical needs to maximize impact and ROI. Proactively identify high-value opportunities, assess risks, and align stakeholders on the best path forward.

Collaborate with Engineering leadership to ensure the future state of the product and technical strategy aligns with long-term goals. Establish and share best practices that strengthen strategic planning and execution across the Product team.

Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to raise the organization’s overall strategic and delivery capabilities. Mentor Product Managers on advanced discovery, stakeholder alignment, and strategic execution.

Requirements: University degree or college diploma in a recognized technical, vocational or academic program (preferably in Engineering or Computer Science) or equivalent work 10+ years of experience in digital or software Product Management. 5+ years of experience as a senior individual contributor or an equivalent role in Product Management, with proven hands-on experience leading and implementing company-wide strategic initiatives across multiple product domains and teams.

Proven success owning the full product lifecycle, from 0 to 1 through scale, ideally in a complex, customer-facing platform or self-serve digital product. Strong ability to dive into technical architecture, understand complex data flows, and make informed decisions about platform, infrastructure, and APIs.

Skilled in building and executing product strategy and long-term roadmaps that tie to business outcomes. Deep understanding of strategic frameworks, linking day-to-day execution with long-term company value. Advanced experience in feature planning, resource management, and prioritization across multiple teams.

Proven track record of improving and scaling product processes in collaboration with product leadership. Strong discovery skills, consistently identifying the right problems, validating with data, and applying structured frameworks.

What You Bring: A thoughtful, data-driven approach to decision making and the confidence to prioritize what matters most. A genuine passion for developing the product craft and problem-solving skills of other product managers. Clear and persuasive communication skills, especially when working with executives and cross-functional teams.

You can work independently, navigate ambiguity with ease, and deliver results. Strategic thinking with a systems mindset, anticipating how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s outcomes. A collaborative and growth-oriented mindset with a passion for mentoring and elevating other Product Managers.

The Position: The Technical Product Manager will contribute to Veracyte ’s success by leading the product strategy, development, and lifecycle management of our Veracyte workflows, driving improvements in laboratory operations, order-to-cash processes, or analytics capabilities.

This role centers on bridging technical and business needs to optimize workflow efficiency, data handoffs, and data integrity.

In addition to core product management duties, the Technical Product Manager will collaborate closely with engineering, clinical, and analytics teams to champion standards-based solutions that enhance operational performance and support data-driven decision-making.

This is a strategic role supporting Veracyte ’s broader digital transformation in laboratory diagnostics, analytics, and order-to-cash processing. This position is based out of our South San Francisco or San Diego office (hybrid) and we are open to remote (US).

Key Responsibilities : Product Ownership & Strategy Own and manage the product backlog, including prioritization and ongoing grooming Define, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps for new product development and sustaining activities Act as the primary product decision‑maker, balancing scope, value, risk, and technical constraints Requirements & Planning Lead scoping discussions and effort estimation exercises with engineering and cross‑functional teams Elicit, document, and manage requirements, translating user and business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria Ensure requirements are well‑defined, traceable, and aligned with overall product strategy Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with clinical, scientific, and business stakeholders to understand workflows, user needs, and success criteria Collaborate closely with engineering, SQA, and operations teams to support design, development, and testing activities Coordinate dependencies and resolve ambiguities to keep delivery on track Delivery & Continuous Improvement Support release planning, execution, and readiness, including defect triage and scope trade‑off decisions Monitor product outcomes and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement Maintain clear product documentation and ensure shared understanding across teams Who You Are: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on technical products in healthcare or software integration.

Prior experience in life sciences or diagnostics required. Experience optimizing at least one of: lab operations, or diagnostic order‑to‑cash, or diagnostic billing/reimbursement workflows, including analytics‑driven systems. Familiarity with Salesforce, or Lab Information Management Systems (LIMS).

Strong technical proficiency, including understanding of APIs, data modeling, cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP), and software development lifecycle. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, regulated industry. For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the salary range is $148,000 - $160,000. For candidates based in our San Diego office, the salary range is $138,000 - $150,000.

Within that mission, the OMRON Connect app plays a critical role as the global front door for millions of users measuring and tracking their health. As Product Owner within the OMRON Connect team, you take ownership of a key part of a globally used consumer health app. You are responsible for turning a legacy-heavy product area into a lean, stable and cost-efficient foundation. The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and international stakeholders, with a strong focus on prioritisation, quality and clarity. You will be making hard trade-offs daily in a high-impact, high-scale environment.
This role is central to how we improve the reliability and scalability of a product that directly influences hardware sales and long-term user engagement. Your work enables us to move faster in the future by first fixing the fundamentals. By bringing structure to complexity, you help reduce technical debt, increase delivery speed and improve product quality across the board. In short: you make it possible for the wider organisation to build with confidence.

You own a critical part of the OMRON Connect app and are responsible for making sure it delivers maximum user and business value with minimal complexity. You operate in a cross-functional, international team and act as the key decision-maker for what gets prioritised, built, improved or removed.

Own and prioritise the backlog for your domain, ensuring focus on user value, business impact and strategic fit.
Drive aggressive descoping to ensure the smallest valuable increments are delivered, while actively reducing technical debt and legacy complexity.
Align a broad international stakeholder landscape and secure clear buy-in on priorities, trade-offs and scope decisions.
Translate fragmented input from stakeholders and users into clear, actionable backlog items that guide engineering effectively.
Own and communicate product vision and roadmap across strategic, tactical and operational levels.
Track and interpret key KPIs (e.g. pairing success, measurement success, data quality, adoption) to continuously refine priorities.
Long term, this role strengthens our ability to operate at global scale. By simplifying and stabilising a complex legacy landscape, you unlock capacity for innovation instead of maintenance. You also help us mature how we work with international stakeholders and regulated environments, improving decision-making speed and consistency. That combination - technical stability and organisational clarity - is what allows us to grow sustainably without increasing chaos.

This role starts on the content platform, and the platform surface it serves is growing. The foundations of the company, identity and access, developer platform, data and the infrastructure everything runs on, are being invested in over the coming year. We are looking for someone whose curiosity does not stop at the edge of their own team, because the interesting problems here sit exactly where those layers meet.
There is genuine ambiguity in this space right now, and a decision or two you would inherit that we have not finished making. We would rather tell you that than have you discover it in month two. The upside is that very little here is set, so the person who takes this shapes the layer everything else in the product is built on for the next several years.

Own the content services every surface depends on. The services and APIs that serve content to the learner surface, the admin surface and everything we build next, plus the delivery path including CDN and video, and file and asset storage.
Own the structural contract. How content is stored, versioned and served so it can be reused and assembled differently for different customers. This is a schema and interface problem before it is a tooling problem, and your measure is whether the contract other teams build against is clear, stable and safe to change.
Own multi tenant separation. Making sure one customer’s content and branding stay theirs. The tenancy model needs a decision and an owner, and that will be one of your first real pieces of work.
Own access, entitlements and data residency. Who can reach what, where data lives, and what we are able to commit to contractually.
Own performance and cost per tenant. If this layer is slow, everything is slow. If it is expensive, it is expensive everywhere.
Carry the platform half of a migration already in flight. We are moving off an incumbent content tool while the current system keeps earning. Sequencing that is the real work, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Own the non functional questions that show up in deals. A meaningful share of our deals slow down in security and compliance review rather than in the pitch, and that is a product problem with a revenue number attached.

s.h: This role is for you if you have
s.t:
Experience with content management as a product, whether that is a CMS, a DAM, a headless content platform or a structured content system at scale. This is our primary preference.
Experience owning platform or infrastructure adjacent product, where success was measured in what other teams could build rather than in features a customer names.
Enough technical depth to be useful and the honesty to say where you are not. You can read an architecture proposal, ask the question that unpicks it, and tell the difference between a researched answer and a fluent one.
The ability to hold your own with senior engineers, infrastructure engineers and security specialists. Not as a peer on implementation, but well enough that a remediation estimate or a tenancy design does not go unchallenged. A previous career as an engineer is a real advantage and not a requirement.
A habit of thinking in seams. Where systems meet, what a contract between them should guarantee, and how to keep a decision reversible rather than walking through a one way door.
The ability to sequence. We are modernising a platform that carries real history while it keeps earning, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Writing. Decisions, tradeoffs and the reasoning behind them, in a way an engineer and an executive can both act on.
Nice to have, and genuinely useful: depth in AI and personalisation, or in infrastructure. Either one compounds with this role, and we are not expecting both.

s.h: This role is not for you if

You want to run a rewrite programme. Foundations serve outcomes, and a foundation with no customer outcome attached does not get funded here and should not.
You need the surrounding decisions settled before you arrive.

s.h: Product Portfolio Senior Manager: Education \& Athletes Pathways
s.t:
================================================================
Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
-----------
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not\-for\-profit academic centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world\-class education and advisory services in sport management.

AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750 alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of international sport.

Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.

---------
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent, prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS\-centred organisation toward an integrated platform combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete\-career transition solutions, and international sport organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning \& Context
----------------------
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships \& Development and the Head of Operations \& Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve according to the deployment of the strategy.

--------------------
**Portfolio Management**
* Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
* Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
* Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability, scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and implementation milestones.
* Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
* Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks, dependencies and investment priorities.
**Product ownership**
**1\. Athlete Pathways**
* Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability, leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
* Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies, sponsors and individual athletes.
* Coordinate athlete\-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
* Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships, partner satisfaction and post\-programme outcomes.
**2\. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) \& Continued Education programmes**
* Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
* Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent and quality\-controlled.
* Lead on the design of the annual Continued Education portfolio across Sport Business, Sport Leadership and Sport Technology, ensuring their relevance for market needs
* Define course value propositions, target segments, learning outcomes, course leaders, pricing logic and annual calendar priorities.
* Source lecturers and guest speakers and, where relevant, supervise MAS Client Team Projects

s.h: **3\. Training Houses and tailored education solution**
s.t:
* Develop repeatable B2B education offers for sport organisations starting with IFs and then NOCs, NFs, LOCs, etc.
* Package tailored education into clear formats, such as staff training, leadership journeys, member federation modules, Olympic Capital Training Weeks and capability\-building workshops ensuring balanced customisation and reusability
**4\. Learning innovation and online support**
* Use digital or online learning selectively to support continuity, blended formats, pre\-work, follow\-up modules or scalable partner needs.
* Contribute to the development of reusable learning assets, templates, cases and content libraries when they improve product quality and scalability.
* Coordinate with academic and industry stakeholders to keep education products relevant to emerging trends such as digital, AI, sustainability, governance, fan engagement and commercial innovation.
**Product team management**
* Manage and coordinate the work with the product coordinator(s).
* Ensure that product owners work closely with Business Development and Marketing for market relevance, positioning and partnerships and with Operations for delivery feasibility.

-------------
* **Dynamic Work Environment:** Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
* **Career Development:** Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
* **Inclusive Culture:** We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders, backgrounds, and experiences.
* **Professional Growth:** Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.
* **Mentorship Opportunities:** Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.
* **Prime Location:** Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the lake

This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.
At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal product - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.
We are looking for a Senior Controls Product Manager to join our newly established Controls Product & Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability).
You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.
⭐ Our Controls team
The role will sit within the Controls Product & Enablement team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline in Monzo’s 1st line of defence Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk & Compliance (the 2nd line of defence).
As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.

s.h: 🔑 What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…
s.t:
Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).
Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.
Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.
Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.
Product Enablement & Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.
Drive Execution & Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…
You think like a Product Manager: You obsess over user problems, value vs. effort prioritization, user experience, and shipping MVPs quickly.
You are a Hands-On Builder: You can get under the hood with data and automation. You're comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), APIs, workflow tools, or low-code environments to build a working prototype yourself.
You’re AI-Curious & Practical: You actively experiment with AI/LLMs to automate manual tasks and make workflows smarter.
You Understand Risk & Controls: You understand fundamental risk concepts (control design, RCSAs, issue management) and see the massive opportunity to transform them through tech.
You Thrive in Ambiguity: You enjoy starting from first principles in a fast-paced environment and turning messy operational problems into slick, scalable digital solutions.
You have experience in leading teams through change programmes, ideally within Financial Services Controls functions.
You are hands-on and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small - and can take a range of stakeholders on the journey with you
You’re excited by what we’re doing at Monzo
ℹ️ This role isn’t for you if…
Your technology and data experience has primarily involved defining requirements for Data or Engineering teams to build, rather than building solutions yourself.
You aren't comfortable getting hands-on with data, automation tooling and technical problem solving.
You aren’t comfortable with ambiguity, or thinking from first principles
You don’t enjoy working in a fast-paced environment
You aren’t happy taking an MVP approach and doing what’s good enough for now with iterative changes to follow
Equally, if your experience is primarily technical and you don't have sufficient understanding of risk and controls to translate control problems into effective solutions, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.
📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.
We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.
You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.
This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.
To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.

Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration
Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes
